events.text:
I've escalated your case to a specialist. They'll follow up within 24 hours about the missing Berry smoothie on order O-5111. I can't promise what they'll decide.

I'm sorry about the trouble you've had with orders lately. Is there anything else I can help with?
Wait, 24 hours? It's only $6.75, and I just want it back on my card. Why is something this small so complicated? I'm not trying to be difficult, I just want to know what's going on.

You're not being difficult, Sofia. It's reasonable to ask.

The amount isn't the issue. We have a safeguard on refunds. When an account has had 3 or more refunds in the last 30 days, a person has to review any new refund, whatever the size. Yours has had 4. The rule applies to every account that reaches that point. It isn't a judgment about you or about this claim.

I'm not allowed to override that review, and I can't issue the refund or a credit while it's pending. I've put the full details in your case (ESC-700). That covers the missing smoothie, the order number, and that you want the money back on your Visa ending 4242. You won't need to explain it again.

The specialist will follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise the outcome, but everything they need is in the case.
Ugh, fine. It's only $6.75 and I've had a lot of hassle with orders this month, so I guess a review makes sense. Just make sure they have all the details so I don't have to repeat myself. Thanks.
